{{Short description|17th-century Italian mathematician}}
[[File:Venturoli - Dialogo aritmetico nel quale si contengono i veri fondamenti dell'arte, dopo il 1664 - 4745958.tif |thumb|''Dialogo aritmetico'' (1664)]]

'''Giacomo Venturoli''' was a 17th-century Italian [[mathematician]].

== Life ==
[[File:Venturoli - Scorta di economia, 1717 - 4746065.tif|thumb|''Scorta di economia'' (1717)]]

Venturoli was a priest and taught [[arithmetic]]. He wrote mainly about [[accountancy]], contributing to the definition and promotion of this newly established discipline. 
In his book ''Scorta di economia'', he mentioned as references the works by [[Angelo Pietra]] and by [[Domenico Manzoni]].<ref>{{cite book|language=it|first=Luigi|last=Serra|title=Storia della ragioneria italiana|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=lkUWAQAAMAAJ|location=Milano|publisher=Giuffrè|date=1999|page=211|isbn=88-14-07428-3}}</ref>
